scope: Window outlines, SF Pro font selection, menu titles, tray icon sizing and the menu bar clock.
approval: Maintainer approved the final clock preview and paired release.

checks.command: Run tests/test_desktop_controls.py with the primary CI SDK (tray artwork, mask changes and clock pointer entry/exit).
Run the selected font, Rounded Corners, layout and clock migration regressions.
Install and reinstall in a disposable KDE neon Wayland guest. Compare the rendered window corner and menu bar at 150% and 200%, and the clock with the macOS reference.
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_topbar_geometry.py (Tahoe menu delegate, horizontal Medium and vertical Normal)

coverage_limits: KDE neon Wayland, Plasma/KWin 6.8.1. The clock text measured 234 by 20 physical pixels at 200% in both editions and the macOS reference. Font rasterization differs.

The optional separate upstream SDK build was skipped in the unit suite. The guest installer built and loaded Rounded Corners. The secondary outline is disabled by default; the upstream shader is unchanged.
The primary CI SDK passed the controls probe. The workstation SDK emitted a pre-existing notification menu width-binding warning on the baseline and candidate.
